title_highlights: 竟成无人出租车首发地
安全员先随车，何时能去掉？

subtitles.en: Self-driving technology startup Wave has reached a deal with Uber to offer RoboTaxi rides in London with a safety driver. It's the latest move in the global race
subtitles.zh: 自动驾驶初创公司Wave与Uber达成协议，将在伦敦推出配备安全员的Robotaxi服务。这是全球自动驾驶出行商业化竞赛的最新举措。

subtitles.en: to commercialise autonomous ride hailing. Wave CEO Alex Kendall is back with us on Bloomberg Tech.
subtitles.zh: Wave首席执行官Alex Kendall再次做客Bloomberg Tech。

subtitles.en: You know Alex, in covering this industry, I know that this is a source of frustration, but the first question is always, what's the path for the safety driver coming out of the vehicle?
subtitles.zh: Alex，在报道这个行业时，我知道这让人沮丧，但第一个问题总是：安全员何时会从车里撤出？

subtitles.en: Take that and explain the London case study to us.
subtitles.zh: 请以此为例，给我们讲讲伦敦的情况。

subtitles.en: Hey Ed, well firstly, as you know, London is an incredibly difficult place to drive.
subtitles.zh: Ed，首先，如你所知，伦敦是一个非常难开车的地方。

subtitles.en: It's a 2000-year-old city. It's full of narrow roads, frequent pedestrians and cyclists, and so I'm delighted that we've been able to bring out technology here. We've been
subtitles.zh: 这是一座有着2000年历史的城市，狭窄的道路、频繁的行人和骑行者，所以我很高兴我们能把技术带到这里。

subtitles.en: learning to drive here for a decade, and it's I think one of the hardest places in the world to learn to drive. But we're starting with a supervised service this week with safety operators
subtitles.zh: 我们在这里学习驾驶已有十年，我认为这是世界上最难学开车的地方之一。但本周我们将从有安全员的监督服务开始。

subtitles.en: in the path to get to launch a driverless service. It's really three things. The first one is to move to a scalable vehicle platform. You know, our business model works with auto makers
subtitles.zh: 要实现无人驾驶服务，需要三件事：第一，转向可扩展的车辆平台。我们的商业模式是与汽车制造商合作，由他们制造Robotaxi，无需改装，而是内置量产硬件。

subtitles.en: so that they build the RoboTaxis, no retrofits, or built-in mass production hardware.
subtitles.zh: 第二，验证无人驾驶所需的安全指标。

subtitles.en: Our second, of course, validating the safety metrics we need for a driverless operation.
subtitles.zh: 其次，当然，验证我们无人驾驶运营所需的安全指标。

subtitles.en: And third, we've got a permit today for supervised operations, and we're working with regulators towards a driverless permit. So those three things, which we're working on very quickly over here
subtitles.zh: 第三，我们今天获得了监督运营的许可，我们正在与监管机构合作，争取获得无人驾驶许可。所以这三件事，我们正在伦敦这里快速推进。

subtitles.en: in London. At the same time, you know, you have multiple projects in parallel, right? There is the driverless platform of Nissan, for example, where there's a future in London. But other cities
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，你们知道，多个项目在并行推进，对吧？比如日产无人驾驶平台，未来在伦敦有应用。但其他城市……
